title: Album genres
statementMd:
List each album genre once.

Expected columns: `genre`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT genre FROM albums;
```
